tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.lv_dis: A 10-block treated wood pole for LV lines: three pin insulators on its crossarm (A, B, C) and the neutral (N) on a bracket below it. Hang a Pole-Mount Transformer on it for split phase.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.mv_sub: A 15-block treated wood pole for MV lines: three porcelain post insulators (A, B, C) on two crossarms, and a shield wire peak on top.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.hv_h_f: A 21-block H-frame of two treated wood poles for HV lines: three glass suspension strings (A, B, C) hung from its crossbeam.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.ehv_la: A 32-block galvanized steel lattice tower for EHV lines: two circuits, each three glass suspension strings (A, B, C) hung from its crossarms.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.pin_in: One insulator, one conductor's end. Mount it on any face of a block to move FE between the block and the grid. All the pin insulators on one block make one port, which needs a whole circuit: A, B and C, or a line and N. Wrench: Configure sets the mode, Sneak + Configure the current limit, Rotate the phase, Port the circuit type.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.wire_c: One bare conductor. Use it on an insulator, then on another of the same tier, to string a wire between them. Sneak-use in the air lets go of the loose end. Keep a wire under its rated current, or it burns out. Live bare wire shocks whatever touches it: LV stings, MV takes a quarter of your health, HV half, EHV kills.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.pole_t: Hang it on the side of a pole. Takes three-phase LV in on its lid (A, B, C) and gives split phase out on its front (L1, N, L2), the neutral carrying only the difference.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.burnt_: What's left of a wire that carried more than its rating for too long.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.wire_c: Use them on a wire to cut it, or on an insulator to cut every wire on it. The wire's coil drops where it was cut.
death.attack.arcforgetransmission.electr: %1$s touched a live wire while fighting %2$s
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.mv_sub: Joins an LV line (its south bushings) to an MV line (its north bushings), three-phase on both sides, through an FE buffer. Wrench on Configure switches it between stepping down (MV in) and stepping up (LV in).
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.hv_sub: Joins an MV line (its south bushings) to an HV line (its north bushings), three-phase on both sides, through an FE buffer. Wrench on Configure switches it between stepping down (HV in) and stepping up (MV in).
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.ehv_su: Joins an HV line (its south bushings) to an EHV line (its north bushings), three-phase on both sides, through an FE buffer. Wrench on Configure switches it between stepping down (EHV in) and stepping up (HV in).
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.unit_t: Links a three-phase line (A, B, C on its lid) to the FE block its cable box faces: place it facing that block. Wrench on Configure sets Input (a generator's step-up onto the line) or Output (feeds a machine from the line, at any voltage).
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.wall_b: Passes wires through a wall. Mount Pin Insulators on its faces: those of one tier and phase are joined through it, so a run comes in one side and leaves the other. Takes an Arcforge Conduit Facade: use a block on the facade to dress it in that block's look.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.insula: Rubber-insulated wire: safe to touch, unlike bare wire, which shocks anything touching it while live. Use it on an insulator, then on another of the same tier, to string a wire.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.bauxit: Aluminium ore. Mine it for Raw Bauxite; smelt that into Aluminium Ingots, or crush it in an Arc Crusher for more dust.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.deepsl: Aluminium ore. Mine it for Raw Bauxite; smelt that into Aluminium Ingots, or crush it in an Arc Crusher for more dust.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.raw_ba: Smelt it into an Aluminium Ingot, or crush it in an Arc Crusher for Aluminium Dust.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.alumin: Light and conductive: MV wire is drawn from it.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.raw_ba: Nine Raw Bauxite, packed. Crush it in an Arc Crusher for Aluminium Dust.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.wire.shield: Grounded steel for the tower peaks (G): catches lightning
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.wire.buried: Underground: insulated, never drawn, out of lightning's reach
message.arcforgetransmission.wire.shield: Shield wire goes on a tower's peak (G) only
That's a shield point (G): use Shield Wire
message.arcforgetransmission.meter.wire: %s %s: %s A of %s A (%s%%) · loss %s FE/t · %s blocks · %s–%s
message.arcforgetransmission.guy.tied: Guy tied to the pole: now use it on the ground
message.arcforgetransmission.guy.too_far: Too far, too high or too many: a guy runs down to the ground within reach
hud.arcforgetransmission.fuse.blown: Fuse blown: use a Fuse Link
hud.arcforgetransmission.breaker.lockout: Locked out: close it by hand
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.fuse_c: One conductor's fuse, hung beside a pole: wire its top (line) and bottom (load). It blows the moment its current passes its rating, long before the wire would burn, opening the line; put it back with a Fuse Link.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.reclos: Three-phase protection: its north bushings (line) joined to its south ones (load) while closed. Over its trip setting it trips open, recloses after a moment, and after its last try locks out. Empty hand opens or closes it; Wrench on Configure sets its trip current.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.circui: Three-phase protection: its north bushings (line) joined to its south ones (load) while closed. Over its trip setting it trips open, recloses after a moment, and after its last try locks out. Empty hand opens or closes it; Wrench on Configure sets its trip current.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.discon: Opens a three-phase line by hand (empty hand): a visible break. Everything past an open switch is dead, so its bare wire is safe to touch.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.dead_e: Ends a line both ways, or turns it a corner: strain insulators on each side, each conductor jumpered through. Place it at 45 degrees for a corner, and guy it.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.servic: A building's service: tie L1, N and L2 from a Pole-Mount Transformer's secondary to its spools, and it feeds the FE block it faces, counting what it delivers.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.surge_: Place it within a few blocks of a transformer: a lightning surge on its line won't destroy it.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.fuse_l: Use it on a blown Fuse Cutout to put it back.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.clamp_: Use it at a wire (or on an insulator) to read its current, rating, loss and length.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.guy_wi: Use it on a pole, then on the ground, to guy it. Sneak-use on the pole to take the last guy off.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.shield: Steel strung between the towers' peaks (their G points) over a line: lightning strikes it, not the conductors.
tooltip.arcforgetransmission.info.underg: Insulated cable run underground: never drawn, safe to touch, and out of lightning's reach.
